capabilities.evidence: existing COM_STMT_SEND_LONG_DATA; 2 MiB value/checksum checks

capabilities.name: LOCAL INFILE reader

capabilities.name: Go 1.27 direct typed row scanning
capabilities.evidence: rows_column_scanner.go; inherited RowsScan and typed/RawBytes benchmarks

capabilities.name: native binary bulk execution
capabilities.evidence: Opt-in BulkExec; real 1/16/100/1000-row tests, unsigned/NULL/DEFAULT/IGNORE, errors and validation-before-send. Aggregate results only.

capabilities.name: per-unit bulk results
capabilities.evidence: WithBulkUnitResults and BulkExecUnits; bounded owned uint64 Id/Affected_rows units, live insert/update/rollback/error/transport checks. No per-row error records or RETURNING contract.

capabilities.name: extended type metadata
capabilities.evidence: Opt-in WithExtendedMetadata; real UUID/INET4/INET6/JSON attributes, Describe and ColumnTypes, caching/DDL/reset and owned bounded parsing. MariaDB 12.3 exposes VECTOR as VARBINARY without a type-name attribute.

capabilities.name: session-state observation
capabilities.evidence: Opt-in WithSessionTracking and pinned InspectSession; bounded OK/terminator blocks and owned last-observed variables/schema, including legacy EOF, errors and reset generations.

capabilities.name: clean connection reset/restoration
capabilities.evidence: Opt-in WithSessionReset and pinned ResetSession; charset/role/schema/ordered params/InitSQL restoration, rollback, private-state cleanup, lazy statement generations, cancellation and retirement. Default checkout remains liveness-only.

capabilities.name: server cursor fetch
capabilities.evidence: WithServerCursors; ordinary database/sql.Rows over read-only COM_STMT_FETCH batches, metadata caching/legacy EOF, early close/reset and cancellation faults. Server materializes SELECT cursors; multiple result sets unsupported.

capabilities.name: io.Reader prepared parameters
capabilities.evidence: ExecStream and StreamParam; chunk-bounded one-shot upload, exact limits/empty/NULL/reader errors, live transport and transaction tests, cancellation phases and bounded allocation with materialization control. Server still bounds complete parameters.

capabilities.name: progress callbacks
capabilities.evidence: WithProgressReports and ExecWithProgress; owned validated reports, real ALTER COPY callbacks on all transport profiles, callback error/panic draining and server-error preservation; no report guarantee or global server-setting changes.

capabilities.name: PARSEC authentication
capabilities.evidence: Built-in parsec plugin; real MariaDB account succeeds, binary challenge/signature and malformed/work-factor unit checks.

capabilities.name: interactive PAM authentication
capabilities.evidence: generic plugin extension exists; no built-in dialog/prompt policy or real PAM fixture

capabilities.evidence: generic plugin extension exists; no built-in GSSAPI/service-principal policy or real KDC fixture
